title: A damaged or full Drive backup tells the member to tap Back up now, a button that no longer exists
what: When a Google Drive backup cannot be read, the member reads 'Make a new backup with Back up now'. When Drive is full, 'Free some space, then tap Back up now'. Uploading to Drive was taken off every screen, so there is no such button and the member is left with no next step.
expected: Each message names a button that is really on the screen, for example Download my data, or says the old Drive backup cannot be used and what to do instead.
who: members restoring an old Drive backup
how_often: each time a Drive backup is damaged or Drive is full
fix_line: Change the two lines to point at Download my data, or say the old backup cannot be used

title: When Drive backup is broken in a build, the member is told to tell their gym, who cannot fix it
what: If the build's Google setup is missing, the Drive restore message ends 'and tell your gym'. The gym owner cannot fix Google setup, and members with no gym have nobody to tell. Help and feedback, which reaches MettleUp, is not mentioned.
expected: The message points to Settings, Help and feedback so the report reaches MettleUp.
who: members restoring from Drive, most of all members with no gym
how_often: every time the build's Google setup is wrong
fix_line: Say 'tell us in Settings, Help and feedback' instead of 'tell your gym'

title: If Google sign-in breaks for a new app build, every member silently loses their only backup and MettleUp is never told
what: The MettleUp account is the one backup, and it works only while Google Cloud has this build's signing fingerprint registered. If that is missing (a new signing key, a lost laptop, a new sideload key), every member reads 'Google sign-in is not ready in this version' and nothing is saved. The real reason is written only to the phone's own log. Nothing reaches MettleUp, so the owner finds out only if a member writes in.
expected: A sign-in failure of this kind is reported to MettleUp automatically, or a release check proves Google sign-in works on the signed build before it ships, and a written note says which fingerprints must be registered.
who: every member of a build whose signing key is not registered
how_often: rare, but all at once when it happens
fix_line: Send this one failure to MettleUp and add a signed-build sign-in check to the release steps

title: The coach's model names are fixed in the app and will stop working when the AI companies retire them
what: The coach (now switched off) offers fixed model names for Claude, OpenAI and Groq. AI companies retire model names without warning; Groq already did this once to another of our apps. The code itself says to update it if one stops working, but nothing tells MettleUp when that happens.
expected: Before the coach is switched on, model names are checked automatically or a retired model falls back to a working one and is reported.
who: members using the coach with their own key, once it is switched on
how_often: each time a provider retires a model
fix_line: Fall back to a working model and report it, before the coach goes live
